sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Cartoon Bricks are simple yet addictive. The game is played on a grid, with bricks arranged in a specific pattern. As you progress through the levels, the bricks become increasingly difficult to break.

The game features a variety of brick types, each with its own unique characteristics. Some bricks are easy to break, while others require a bit more effort. You'll also encounter special bricks, such as the bonus brick, which awards you extra points when broken. The game also features power-ups, which can be earned or purchased using in-game currency. These power-ups can give you an edge over the bricks, helping you to break them more efficiently.

The game's controls are simple and easy to use, making it accessible to players of all ages. You can use your finger, mouse, or keyboard to play the game. The controls are responsive and accurate, allowing you to swipe or click your way to victory. With its simple controls and addictive gameplay, Cartoon Bricks is the perfect game for players who want to challenge themselves without getting frustrated.

The game also features a leaderboard, where you can compare your scores with other players. This adds an extra level of competition and challenge to the game, making it even more addictive.
